name: 1stpage
description: Amazon Seller Central, Vendor Central and Amazon Ads analytics: ask about sales, advertising, Search Query Performance, inventory and forecasts, listing quality and keyword rankings, and set up product-level alerts and scheduled reports, using the Amazon accounts you connected to 1stPage.

interface.longDescription:
Amazon Seller Central, Vendor Central and Amazon Advertising analytics in ChatGPT. 1stPage connects ChatGPT to the Amazon seller, vendor and ads accounts you have linked to 1stPage, so you can ask about sales, ads, inventory and forecasts in plain language.

Sellers can ask why sales moved last week, which products drive growth or decline and how today's sales are pacing. Vendors can report on Vendor Central ordered and shipped revenue by product. Ask how your Sponsored Products, Brands and Display campaigns perform, which search terms waste spend, what share of search you win in Amazon's Search Query Performance data, which products are forecast to stock out and what to restock, and which listings need content fixes. You can also set up product-level alerts and recurring reports delivered by email or Slack, and manage organic keyword rank tracking.

For Amazon sellers, vendors and the agencies that manage their accounts. Requires a 1stPage account with at least one connected Amazon account; you only see accounts your 1stPage user can access. Data follows Amazon's reporting schedules, so the most recent one to three days can still change. 1stPage reads your Amazon data and does not change prices, listings or campaigns on Amazon.
capabilities: Amazon Ads performance (Sponsored Products, Brands, Display)
defaultPrompt: Why did my Amazon sales change last week?
Which search terms are wasting my ad spend this month?
Which of my products are at risk of stocking out?

positive.description: Broad business health check on the demo seller account
positive.prompt: How is my Amazon business doing over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Brightwell Home (Demo) seller account and summarizes last-30-day sales versus the prior 30 days with the dates used, the top products, any sales or advertising alerts, and inventory risks such as low-stock products. All figures come from the demo account's sample data.

positive.prompt: What was the TACoS for the Brightwell bamboo cutting board set over the last 30 days?
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the bamboo cutting board set, retrieves its total sales (seller_analytics dataset realtime_sales) and its attributable ad spend (advertising_analytics dataset spend_by_asin) for the same window, and reports sales, spend and TACoS as a percentage with the dates covered.

positive.prompt: Which search terms bring the most traffic to my products, and where is my click share weakest?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the top search queries for the demo brand with search volume, impressions, clicks and purchases, and points out queries where the brand's click or purchase share is low relative to its impression share.

positive.prompt: Audit my Amazon listing quality and tell me the three listings that need the most work.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the account's listing-quality score and scan date, then names the three lowest-scoring demo listings with their specific findings (for example a short title, missing bullets or too few images) and a suggested fix for each.

positive.prompt: Show the organic keywords I'm tracking for the Brightwell brand and how their rankings changed over the last two weeks.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the Brightwell brand, lists its tracked keywords and target products, and summarizes each keyword's organic rank trend over the last 14 days from stored observations, noting improvements and declines.

negative.description: Recurring report without a delivery destination: the plugin must ask where to send it instead of inventing an address or creating a schedule
negative.prompt: Send me a weekly sales report every Monday morning.

negative.description: Changing prices on Amazon is outside the plugin's capabilities: it should explain that 1stPage reads Amazon data and cannot change prices, and offer related analysis instead
negative.prompt: Lower the price of my cutting board set to $19.99 on Amazon.

negative.description: Data for an Amazon account the user has not connected: it should explain that only connected accounts are available and not guess figures
negative.prompt: Show me last month's sales for my competitor Acme Kitchen's Amazon store.

review.commerce_description: 1stPage does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT; it reads analytics for Amazon accounts the user already connected to 1stPage.

publication.release_notes: Listing update: clearer description of Seller Central, Vendor Central, Amazon Ads, inventory forecasting and product-level alert coverage, plus discovery keywords. No tool or skill changes.
